title: Clear Harvest Market
hook: A serious local-market build that blends brand story, food commerce, recipe sales, visitor messaging, and a new admin/superadmin marketing backend scaffold.
sections: Family-brand market site for artisan bread, juice, baked goods, preorder flows, and $1 recipes.
Moves the business beyond a basic info page into a stronger Truckee/Tahoe commerce and growth system.
Homepage, order hub, recipe shop, partner page, story page, juice page, admin backend, and lead/payment scaffolds.
Truckee locals, Tahoe visitors, cabin hosts, catering buyers, and digital recipe customers.
SEO/social/video -> lead capture -> order or recipe checkout -> repeat order, upsell, and local business growth.
Add auth, datastore, real autoposting, live CRM behavior, and more food/product-specific content.
